response.justification: Bogdan brings roughly 15+ years of hands-on engineering across web, backend, mobile, and embedded systems, plus founder experience with an open-source geo-data platform and a strong record of teaching and public speaking — all relevant to the craft and communication aspects of the role. However, the position is a Director-level IC focused on AI strategy, requiring recognized AI expertise, demonstrated AI products or platforms, and deep cloud-platform influence. His profile is that of a senior/staff hands-on developer: AI exposure is limited to recent MCP tooling work, cloud experience is mostly AWS CDK and Kubernetes deployment rather than platform strategy, and there is no evidence of advising strategic customers, shaping product direction at scale, or org-level technical leadership. The gap between senior IC delivery and principal-level AI strategy is substantial.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, hands-on engineering across many stacks and domains
Founder of an open-source platform plus multiple maintained OSS libraries
Strong knowledge-sharing track record: conference talks, workshops, courses
concerns: Minimal demonstrated AI/ML expertise or AI products shipped at scale
No director-level, principal, or strategic advisory experience evident
Cloud work is implementation-level, not platform or product strategy

key_factors.factor: Seniority mismatch vs. Director-level IC scope
Depth and breadth of engineering experience
